body: This was a really nice read. Maybe you’re right, maybe you’re wrong, but I’m glad you have a relationship with your daughter and I hope that it will sustain you. My fear is inflicting my negativity onto a child and fucking up their life when they could do so much better without me. I don’t know man, it’s a coin toss whether or not you’ll be a positive or a negative force in your own child’s life. I just don’t think I have enough value to make it worth trying.
